name: warminboxes
description: Cold email deliverability and infrastructure for Claude. Connects WarmInboxes Free MCP (read-only diagnostics, DNS, blocklists, placement guidance, sizing and pricing; no key) and adds five skills: burned-domain check, pre-send domain audit, list segmentation by recipient provider, fleet sizing, and a guide to connecting a WarmInboxes account with an API key when someone is ready to order or manage inboxes.
